title: Do not spend the passing day in gossip
summary: This meets restless speech that keeps burning through a life already brief. The line places passing-world clarity beside lies, slander, and gossip.
takeaway: Do not waste a passing life on gossip.
lifeApplication: Before repeating the story or sharpening the comment, feel the tongue and throat. Let the shortness of life interrupt the pleasure of saying it.

source.shortMeaning: A passing life is squandered when the tongue feeds on gossip.
source.lifeApplication: When gossip feels easy, remember how quickly the body passes.

evidence.coreClaim: A passing life is squandered when the tongue feeds on gossip.
evidence.turn: Remember the shortness of life before you spend it in gossip.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before repeating the story or sharpening the comment, feel the tongue and throat. Let the shortness of life interrupt the pleasure of saying it.
